title: Edit Recorded Steps
description: Atomically clean a stopped single-recording draft before save: remove incorrect exploration or redundant steps, change recorded form values or anchored inserted text, and move a step before another step on the same page. Targets remain those captured by the recorder.
guidance: Navigation effects stay attached to their gesture. Cross-page moves, arbitrary selectors, scripts, paths and URLs are not accepted. No page action or workflow execution occurs. Read the steps again after each edit; finish naming and save only after the original task is done. Do not run the newly saved workflow.
